card.name: "the" after enhance, increase, alter
card.fires_on: The word "the" (rarely "their" or "of") right after a verb like enhance, increase or alter in drug-interaction sentences. It comes just before a term such as exposure, plasma concentration or pharmacokinetics.

modes.label: Verb then "the"
modes.description: "the" follows enhance, increase or alter, with a drug or enzyme inhibitor as the subject.
modes.example: Asenapine sublingual tablets may enhance<< the>> inhibitory effects of paroxetine on its

modes.label: Negated alter
modes.description: "the" follows "unlikely to alter" or "not expected to alter" in enzyme-interaction statements.
modes.example: Eribulin is not expected to alter<< the>> plasma concentrations of drugs that are substrates

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.example: Coadministration of VITRAKVI with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may increase<< their>> plasma concentrations, which may increase the incidence

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from words like synergy and momentum, toward concrete terms about drug levels.
card.plain: It marks the small word after a verb like "increase" or "enhance" in drug-interaction statements, right before drug levels or effects are named.
